nom: belif Dew Guard Milky Sun Serum Hydrating Sunscreen SPF 40

avis.texte: I bought this becsuse i saw it on a coworker's face and the glow/highlight from it was incredible. When I tried mine out it was AMAZING. One of the best purchases to date and I buy a TON of quality skin care.

belif Dew Guard Milky Sun Serum SPF 40 is a strong pick for someone wanting a daily sunscreen that feels like skincare. It is hydrating, lightweight, pleasant to wear, with skin‑care benefits (niacinamide, HA, cica). It may not be perfect for every climate or skin type (especially very oily / super sweaty days), but for moderate conditions it delivers well.

I love that this sunscreen has gentle, skin-friendly ingredients like cica, niacinamide, and hyaluronic acid with a refreshing citrus scent. My skin is sensitive and gets oily easily, but this formula works great for me. It is lightweight, absorbs fast and does not leave any greasy feel or white cast. It also wears nicely under makeup.

This is definitely becoming part of my sunny days routine. I got to try the Sun Serum during hot-humid days and it hold on good. The applicator is great and the product is readily absorbed by the skin, lightweight. It has soft and pleasant citrus scent to it that is actually enjoyable and not heavy. Buying again!
Luv this sunscreen because it's not thick but I wish it came in a bigger package.
A great serum to go under your regular skin care routine. I like that it does not leave my skin sticky and gives a slight dewy finish. I have combination skin, and it works for my skin type.

I haven't seen a serum with SPF in it before, so I was super excited to try this! It definitely works and adds an extra layer for protection while moisturizing the skin. I have added this to my daily skincare routine and am obsessed!!!

I loved this product! It blended so easily and smelled just like a beach vacation. As a black woman, this blended into my skin seamlessly which is usually an issue for me. No purple or white cast at all! I would even feel comfortable applying this on my kids as well.
It smells really nice and it's light and not too heavy and it doesn't leave a white cast and the texture is really smooth and soft and it's perfect.

avis.titre: A new staple in my skincare routine!
avis.texte: I was surprised by how much I loved this! I've struggled with finding an SPF that doesn't cause my other skincare products/makeup to pill or leave me feeling overly greasy. The sunscreen goes on like a serum and truly does leave a dewy finish that lasts all day. I've been loving this for no-makeup days where I just want a natural glow. I also love the scent! I already have several SPFs in my lineup, but this will be the one I repurchase.
Very light feeling and works well! It's very hydrating also. Highly recommend!

I received the Dew Guard Milky Sun Serum SPF 40 for free in exchange for a review. It gives my skin a gorgeous dewy glow without crossing into oily territory. I love how lightweight and breathable it feels on the skin. Since using it consistently, I've also seen a noticeable improvement in my skin with fewer breakouts. I wasn't expecting it to help with acne, but somehow it's doing exactly that. Love this product
As a girly with fair skin, SPF is a must. I love being able to apply it with every layer for ultimate protection. It goes on smooth, feels so great on the skin.
Such a great product to wear underneath makeup! Makes my skin glowy and hydrated. This doesn't pill under foundation and smells nice.

I've been on the market for a good sunscreen. First, I love the container it comes in. It's so easy to use inside and on the go. Most of these sunscreens make my eyes water. Which can be highly annoying when I'm out and about. But this sunscreen right here didn't do that at all! Didn't have to spend all day wiping my eyes. My skin felt so moisturized using this as well. It pairs very well with my skincare routine too. This is a wonderful addition to my routine. Will definitely refill once I run out.
I love this product! It is lightweight, non greasy, absorbed quickly leaving no oily feeling on my face.

I've been using the belif Dew Guard Milky Sun Serum SPF 40 for awhile now, and honestly, it's become one of my favorite sunscreens. The texture is super lightweight and feels more like a serum than a typical sunscreen, no greasiness, no heavy film, and most importantly, no white cast. I have combo skin that leans dry in the winter and oily in the summer, and this formula somehow manages to hydrate without making me shiny or clogging my pores. It wears beautifully under makeup, doesn't pill, and my skin actually feels softer after applying it. I also love that it's dermatologist tested and non comedogenic. It gives me peace of mind knowing I'm getting solid UVA/UVB protection without compromising how my skin looks or feels. Plus, it has a soft, clean scent that isn't overpowering. Definitely a win in my book.

Belif sent me a free sample of their new Dew Guard Milky Sun Serum SPF 40 in exchange for a review, and I was genuinely impressed! I really enjoyed using this sunscreen serum — it's lightweight, hydrating, and feels great on the skin. Finding a good facial sunscreen has always been a challenge for me. Most formulas tend to be greasy, cause breakouts, or leave a white cast. Thankfully, this serum is the complete opposite. It gives my skin a subtle, healthy glow without any greasiness or irritation. I've worn it almost daily, both under makeup and at the pool, and I haven't experienced any breakouts or white cast. I also appreciate the packaging — the squeeze bottle makes application quick and easy. Overall, this is a product I would definitely recommend!

avis.titre: Im going to buy this product when it runs out
avis.texte: I use this product everywhere I want to glow! Hydrates skin, very lightweight texture, no white cast. More of a serum. I do not need to use moisturizer this does the trick. I love it!! Obsessed
This sunscreen is very light but very hydrating. It doesn't make your face feel sticky or leave a weird residue and works beautifully under makeup!

Okay, so I've been using this SPF serum for a couple of weeks now, and honestly? I'm kind of in love. First off, the texture is so satisfying—it's lightweight but creamy enough to feel like you're actually putting something nourishing on your skin, not just another watery layer. It goes on super smooth and sinks in quickly, which is great for those rushed mornings when I'm slapping on skincare and trying to look alive. No white cast (thankfully), and it leaves this dewy-but-not-greasy finish that makes my skin look fresh, not shiny. Also, bonus it layers really well under makeup. No pilling, no weird texture issues. It's not like I'm lounging in the sun all day, but it's nice knowing my face is protected when I'm running errands or just walking the dog. And my skin's been feeling noticeably softer and more hydrated throughout the day. Would recommend if you're looking for something that multitasks and feels good going on. SPF + moisture in one step = yes, please.

This sunscreen goes on like a dream! It's lightweight, smooth, and completely invisible. It gives a healthy, dewy glow without feeling greasy or heavy, and it layers perfectly under my makeup. I also love the added skincare ingredients like niacinamide, cica, and hyaluronic acid. It definitely hydrates and soothes while also protecting. I love that it combines SPF and skincare benefits!

This serum is definitely worth it! Fragrance free, smooth & silky, and doesn't leave residue or white-cast. Unlike others, this doesn't take a lot of product to cover your face, and it definitely doesn't smell like normal sunscreen. It's so light-weight, I forgot I had a on a few times.

I'm not exaggerating when I say that this is one of the best sunscreens on the market. Zero white cast so it's perfect for daily use. It is hydrating and not greasy - feels so good on my skin. SPF 40 so lots of protection. It's not thick or irritating. I've used it everyday for two weeks now and I'm so happy with it. This is a new staple in my skincare.
I have enjoyed this on my face and body. I even mixed it with my regular body cream to make sure I was protected.

I am loving this sunscreen serum so much! The texture is perfectly silky smooth and it leaves a radiant glowy finish that isn't shiny at all. I apply tinted moisturizer over it and it blends seamlessly, never pills. This is truly a new favorite that I will continue to repurchase!

I HATE using sunscreen on my face. I usually breakout so bad, and they're just so thick and gross feeling. I was so excited to try this. It's great! I got minimal breakouts (like seriously 1, maybe 2 pimples), but I think my skin is just so sensitive. It feels so good going on, it isn't thin. And the scent is great! I used it on my boys at the ball field over the weekend, and they both commented on the scent. I really am so pleased with this.

I was excited to try this sunscreen and upon first feel it is light weight and feels hydrating. It has a very subtle scent that doesn't linger. It is definitely dewey but almost in the shiny side. I have dry skin and love anything dewey but even for me this was a bit much.

I received this product complimentary from belif to review. I've been using this as my daily SPF for over a week now. It doesn't leave a white cast on my face and I don't feel like the product is cloying. It didn't break me out as much as other spf products seem to do. I'm happy to keep using this every day.

avis.titre: Perfect for travel and everyday use
avis.texte: Perfect for travel and everyday use. I use it daily especially if I know I will out in the sun. Its a perfect size that fits in my makeup bag. I love the smell of this product. Its a orange sweet smell. It's comes out white milky and disappears to a silky smooth finish.
The lotion smells great, absorbs well, and lasts long! Would definitely purchase.
Absorbed quickly into my skin, gave me good sun protection, and it has a nice light weight texture perfect for applying make up on top of. Love that it's fragrance free!!!

I have been using it for 5 days now and I love it. Its lightweight, it feels similar to the beauty of joseon sunscreen in texture. Perfect for the summer, doest burn my eyes (like so many US sunscreens do)

avis.titre: I've been using the Dew Guard Milky Sun Serum SPF 40 for a f
avis.texte: What sets this product apart is its unique texture — it has a milky, lightweight consistency that feels more like a serum than a traditional sunscreen. As someone with combination skin, I often struggle to find sun protection that doesn't clog my pores or leave a greasy residue, but this one absorbs beautifully without any stickiness or white cast. The application is smooth and effortless. It glides onto the skin and instantly gives a fresh, dewy finish that makes my skin look naturally radiant. I also appreciate how hydrating it is. It contains skin-loving ingredients that leave my face feeling soft and moisturized throughout the day, so it's perfect for those who want both sun protection and skincare benefits in one step. What really impressed me is how well it layers under makeup. Some sunscreens can pill or make foundation slide around, but this sun serum works almost like a primer. My makeup goes on smoothly and stays put longer, which is a huge plus. The SPF 40 provides strong enough protection for daily wear, whether I'm indoors most of the day or out for a walk in the sun. In addition to the performance, the packaging is sleek and travel-friendly, making it easy to carry in my bag for touch-ups. It doesn't have an overpowering scent either — just a light, pleasant fragrance that fades quickly after application. Overall, Dew Guard Milky Sun Serum SPF 40 is a standout product that combines the benefits of skincare and sun protection in one elegant formula. It's ideal fo

This is truly an amazing product. It's incredibly easy to apply, thanks to its smooth, milky texture that gently hydrates your face. I love how it keeps my skin feeling soft and moist all day long, never leaving it dry or uncomfortable. What really stands out to me is how it doesn't leave behind that annoying white residue that other sunscreens often do. I genuinely feel so pleased with this find—I would definitely buy it again without hesitation. It's become my absolute go-to for daily sun protection, and I can't imagine my routine without it.
This product is good for those with dry skin. It's hydrating yet still not thick or greasy. It sits well under my makeup also. I do wish it was tinted but overall would buy again.
I really like this SPF as a base layer. It is easy to apply. Goes on without any visible residue. Final moisturizer, foundation goes on easily on-top. Would recommend.

avis.titre: A must have for your everyday routine
avis.texte: Super light sunscreen to wear everyday!! Doesn't go in super thick which I love. No white residue.

This sunscreen has a pleasant scent that doesn't feel overwhelming. However, I have oily skin, and while this formula is certainly hydrating, I thought it made my face look and feel greasy. If you have dry skin, you'll LOVE this product! It layers well under makeup, though!
Love, does not worsen texture, light and sheer finish, I would buy it in a heartbeat

This serum is silky, instantly absorbs, and dries down quickly. It has a nice light yet subtle fragrance. It didn't feel like I was wearing anything yet my skin felt moisturized and dewy. I'm definitely adding this to my routine. Recommend. I received this product for free in exchange for writing the review.

Dewy Guard Glow boost is a great facial sunscreen option with a decent price point. The formula leaves a dewy glow as advertised and can double as a day time moisturizer for those with combination skin, (note-I would not recommend this sunscreen for very oily skin types). The sunscreen comes out like a milky serum and has a faint citrus scent that quickly fades. The sunscreen goes on very easily and leaves no visible white cast or chalky effect, even when I accidentally over applied it. Depending on the days activities and humidity level it can be a bit too dewy but this can be remedied by skipping day time face moisturizer. Helps my skin feel beautiful, protected, and healthy!
I used this every day since I had it and my skin feels awesome. I like the way it smooths on the benefits.

avis.titre: Not Sure It Is Worth It
avis.texte: As an outdoor girls with fair and sensitive skin, spf products are a must! Indeed this had a serum like consistency so it does glide on beautifully. Also doesn't irritate my skin and does provide sun care as promised. However it isn't any better than a face specific spf one can buy otc,such as Neutrogena or Aveeno, both of which are half the price of this product. Reviewer recieved product for free as tester.

I like how dewy this leaves the skin. Very faint smell. It's very light weight/watery. And while I like the light weight I don't love the watery, while I do appreciate how the skin drinks it up and the hydration provided. It's a quality product and while I will use the bottle I was given in exchange for a review I think I prefer a stick spf in the summer for reapplication. I will be trying again in the winter months for extra hydration though.

avis.titre: Does what it says it will.
avis.texte: I've been using the Dew Guard Milky Sun Serum SPF 40 and I'm really impressed. The texture is lightweight and silky, almost like a moisturizer, which makes it super easy to apply without leaving a greasy or heavy feeling. It absorbs quickly and gives my skin a nice, natural glow without a white cast. I love that it feels hydrating throughout the day while still providing solid sun protection. One of the best things about this product is how well it layers with my other skincare and makeup—it doesn't pill or feel sticky. It's perfect for daily use, especially if you're looking for a sunscreen that feels more like skincare than a traditional sunscreen. Overall, it's a great option for people who want sun protection with a smooth, dewy finish. I would definitely repurchase and recommend it to anyone looking for a comfortable, skin-friendly SPF.

I got this as a free product to try out and review. I thought the packaging was cute, and was excited to give it a try! When I first applied it to my face I thought it absorbed nicely and left a dewy finish. However within a few minutes it began to irritate my eyes. I tried it another time and had the same reaction. Bummer!! I have continued to use it, just not on my face. I would recommend it to anyone without sensitive skin.

avis.titre: i would buy this product again
avis.texte: this was really great and effective as a stand alone however i did put this under my makeup and it cause some pillys on my face after makeup application but great as a solo spf i love this brand for the summer
Feels so lightweight, smells great, and has no white cast. I would definitely recommend this.

This is a light cream. Goes on pretty smoothly and absorbs quickly. Does not leave a white cast. Gives my skin a slight glow appearance. My only dislike of it, and its a super mild dislike, is when you put it on the scent isn't supposed to be a citrus smell but to me it just smells like lemon Pledge....I feel like that can be improved on. Overall though, fairly satisfied with my test product and ended up mostly just using it on my hands and arms due to the "lemon" smell which i was not a fan of.

avis.titre: A good SPF for fans of a dewy look
avis.texte: Thanks to belif for the free Dew Guard Milky Sun Serum SPF 40! Pros: This product is very light and applies easily. It leaves a VERY dewy finish so if you're someone who loves that look, it makes a great base for a naturally highlighted summery face. I love that it's SPF 40 as I'm always on the hunt for more sun protection. Cons: If you apply facial oils as part of your skincare routine, you might need to wait quite a bit before applying the SPF so you don't end up with an oil slick. Related to this, I did have some pilling near my hairline. So I definitely recommend letting your skincare fully dry down and sit for about 10 min before applying the SPF (which may be inconvenient if you're in a rush.) This product is pretty strongly fragranced. If you are sensitive to fragrances, I would skip. Overall, this is a solid choice for SPF that adds a healthy, dewy look to the skin while protecting against sun damage. I would recommend!
This product it's light Dewey without the white cast. Leaves my skin feeling good you can wear it with foundation. It smells like lemon.

This sun serum is lightweight, is lightly scented, absorbs into the skin effortlessly, moisturizes, and provides sun protection. It's a great every day product. I had no problems wearing it under my makeup. The scent is great and I love how easy it is to apply.
For a fair skin ginger, this is by far the best sunscreen I have ever used!
I use this sun serum for about a week and I love it very light weight and perfect for a everyday wear I love it highly recommend

avis.titre: Sun protection with a dewy glow
avis.texte: Belif sent me this free sample to give my honest review and I was very excited to try it! I love skin care products and this is a good one. I have rosacea and it didn't irritate my sensitive skin. I used it after my normal moisturizer and it goes on clearly and smells nice. I felt like it absorbed into my skin well and moisturized. Plus, I definitely noticed the "dewy" glow! The only negatives I noticed are that it's only SPF 40- I'm pale and I prefer SPF 50+. Also, I wish it came in a tinted version (again, I'm pale!).

avis.titre: This will be my family's new go to sunscreen.
avis.texte: I've used this product for sun protection over the last few days and all I can say is that the formula has been very impressive. The sunscreen is lightweight and perfect for my sensitive skin. There is no white cast or scent.

I applied this sunscreen all over my body. It came out of the bottle white lotion but as I was applying it, it was rubbing into my skin it started to soak in right away and you could no longer see it. It didn't leave any white marks, it dried quickly. It didn't leave my skin sticky or slimy or rub off on my clothes. It has a very light summery smell. Protected well and reapplied after 2 hours. The only thing would be the size of the bottle. It would need to come in bigger sizes.
I thought this product was pretty great. It absorbed into my skin really well and didn't pill if I applied makeup over it. My skin type is normal and my coloring is pretty pale

avis.titre: I would buy this product again
avis.texte: This sunscreen serum glides smoothly on the skin and feels more like skincare than sunscreen.Unlike mineral sunscreens, this blends very well. Contains ingredients like niacinamide, hyaluronic acid, and panthenol — all great for dry or dehydrated skin.It works well under makeup and doesn't feel greasy or sticky. But it contains chemical UV filters (Avobenzone, Homosalate, Octocrylene, Octisalate) — these are effective but may not be suitable for those with allergy-prone, or post-treatment skin (e.g., after chemotherapy or radiation).
Belif was a lifesaver on my trip to Las Vegas. I absolutely enjoyed wearing this product and it gave me the sun protection that I needed.

Love the milky texture of this spf. Easy to spread, feels lightweight and hydrating. It does have a strong herbal scent that threw me off on first application. I didn't experience any irritation or eye sting, but I tend to prefer products without fragrance in general. I also wish this was spf50. But this sunscreen is nice to apply, feels light on the skin, with no white cast ! It's worth a try if you're in the market!
I liked that this product is hydrating and has sun protection but it was irritating on my skin. It may just not be compatible for my skin but it is worth trying for others.

This SPF serum is amazing. It leaves my face feeling so hydrated and moisturizer. It has no white cast and doesn't have an ugly chemical smell. It's not thick or oily on the skin like other SPF moisturizers I have tried. I highly recommend this one. U really won't be disappointed.

avis.titre: I would buy this product again.
avis.texte: I've been using the Belif Dew Guard Milky Sun Serum SPF 40,it's become one of my favorite daily sunscreens.What I love most is how lightweight and silky it feels. It absorbs super fast, doesn't leave a white cast, and doesn't feel greasy or sticky at all. It's more like a hydrating serum than a heavy sunscreen.
This is great sunscreen for under makeup. Not heavy, does not leave a white cast. Love it.

avis.titre: The best thing I've tried for sun damage.
avis.texte: I loved this sunscreen; it helps so much against sun damage. It's great. The consistency is perfect. It absorbs into my skin very quickly. It has a light orange scent. It's great. This is the first time I've tried a sunscreen from this brand, and I love it. I highly recommend it. When I run out, I'll buy another one.🥰

avis.titre: Great sunscreen that checks all the boxes!
avis.texte: It's hard to find a great sunscreen that is not greasy, absorbs well, works well under makeup, does not have a scent, and does not leave a white cast. This sunscreen checks all those boxes! It's hydrating, but not oily. There is no typical sunscreen scent. It's a thin, serum style formula, but still provides the coverage needed to protect my skin. Would buy again!

I was interested in trying this after my daughter got really bad sun poisoning on her face. This is sun serum for your face it's spf 40 sun screen so this is definitely going to protect your face this has a white milky cast but once rubbed in to your skin it's colorless. It feel so hydrating and makes my skins soft I love the way this feels on my face. And glad I got a good product my kids can use when they are out in the sun and I love love the smell of this it's got like a citrus smell best smell from a sunscreen I've ever used. I'm highly impressed with this product it's worked well out in the sun and makes your face feel great don't pass this one up you won't regret it
This arrived for me right before the heatwave last week in NY. I apply this sunscreen under my makeup. Goes on like it's a face moisturizer, no white cast, no oily residue. I love it!

This sun serum has an incredibly lightweight texture that glides on smoothly and absorbs quickly, leaving no greasy or heavy residue. It layers seamlessly under makeup, providing a flawless finish without any pilling or breakouts. My skin looks radiant with a soft, healthy glow, and I'm happy to report that it leaves no unsightly white cast. I highly recommend it!
Love this sunscreen, it's very lightweight, no white cast and leaves a nice glow. I also like that it works well under makeup, but I wish it had a higher SPF
This feels more like skincare than sunscreen. It's super lightweight, no white cast, and gives a natural dewy glow without feeling greasy. Works perfectly under makeup too.

Dew Guard Milky Sun Serum SPF 40 is an amazing product especially for the summer. It's really lightweight but at the same time highly moisturising. It absorbs immediately without leaving white cast or any oily residue. It has a high SPF factor so you can feel protected and glowing.

avis.titre: Best no white cast sunscreen plus serum
avis.texte: I'm using Dew guard Glow Boost Serum for couple of days it has no white cast like not even 1% white cast. It smooths out quickly on skin gives healthy glowy skin with sun protection. It's really light weight doesn't feel like your wearing SPF and makeup goes over really smoothly. Added benefit of skin care is a plus with vitamin C , niacinamide and Hyaluronic acid. It's perfect skincare and spf combo. Thank you for the sample Belif, will be purchasing it soon.

I just had a pool installed this summer. Finally! So I've been spending an enormous amount of time outside in the sun. I've spent countless dollars on my face getting brown patches taken off with chemical peels from Sun damage. So I've been needing a new sunscreen for my face other than the mineral oil based ones dermatologists want me to use. But they break me out!! So sick of this vicious cycle. Getting this Dew Guard sunscreen for my face has been a God send! I've been using it every day while I'm out in the pool and I haven't had a single breakout from it in a week of use. It goes on so silky smoothe, and doesn't feel heavy or sticky or burn my eyes. My skin looks hydrated and supple. No new patches of dark skin, no pimples, so sunburn. Just healthy dewy skin. Highly recommend!!

I was very pleased with this cream. First, I love that it has SPF 40 in it. That comes in very handy this time of year when I'm outdoors more often. It was very lightweight and blended in wasily wuthout leaving any white residue behind. it did great protecting my face from the sun ad wrll ad leaving my skin feeling hydrated. It has a very light pleasant fragrance that disappeared pretty quickly. overall i would recommend this profuct.

Dew Guard Milky Sun Serum SPF 40 is a game-changer for anyone who hates the typical sunscreen feel. It's lightweight and absorbs quickly, leaving my skin feeling hydrated and dewy, not greasy. I've been using it every day under makeup, and it creates a smooth base without any pilling.
I love trying new skincare that actually has SPF in it, this is lightweight and perfect for summer. I wore this on its own and I love the way it made my skin look and feel.

avis.titre: I would buy this product again i love it!
avis.texte: I have no complaints here. I am porcelain skinned, so wearing sunscreen is important. It did not break me out, i was able to put makeup and stuff over top of it worked great. I did not get burned to being out in 100 degree weather and out all day on vacation. No greasy residue I have oily skin combination.
Pleasantly surprised when I used this product. It was easy to put on my dry skin. Very moisturizing. Not greasy at all!
If you are looking for a lightweight spf serum this is it!! I absolutely love this product and will be a customer for life!

avis.titre: I would definitely recommend this product!
avis.texte: I love the belif skincare line and was super excited to try this product as I have been trying to incorporate sunscreen into my skin care routine.
Really love how this goes on. Nice n silky just as the product claims. Leaves 0 residue and is completely transparent. Didn't burn either! 10/10

The product claims are all there. Dewy and lightweight on the skin without leaving a white cast is all true. This product didn't make me break out and is great as a primer because it plays nice with other products. Definitely a easy to use serum that leaves your skin glowing and dewy.

I received this product for free for my honest review. I love this product. It's really light weight, doesn't leave any residue, and protects my skin all day. It has a very light scent and absorbs quickly. My skin looks hydrated immediately after use. I highly recommend this product.
I use Belif Moisturizing Bomb so I was excited to give theirs unscreen a try. It is so light and love how it feels on my skin.

I really loved how this serum felt on first application directly from finger to skin. It had a light citrusy scent, not overpowering at all. It was easy to apply and I felt like it coated my skin well without being flimsy. It absorbed easily onto my face and didn't feel heavy. Loved how it didn't give my face a white cast after rubbing onto skin, it blended so easily. I felt like it gave my face an almost matte look. I used this serum for 3 days straight, applied right after brushing teeth. Will definitely be using this sun serum this Summer!

avis.titre: A must have in your daily skincare
avis.texte: I am absolutely in love with this product! Over the past several months, I've tried numerous SPF-based serums from high-end brands that claimed to leave no white cast—yet most still did, or left my skin feeling oily with an unpleasant residue. That's why discovering a product that not only delivers on its promises but also makes my skin look and feel better is truly refreshing. Belif's Dew Guard Milky Sun Serum SPF 40 has completely revitalized my skincare routine. I was initially a bit hesitant when I opened the twist-off cap and saw the milky white serum, but I was quickly and pleasantly surprised. The texture is silky, lightweight, and it blended into my skin effortlessly—and best of all, no white cast at all! Beyond the smooth and lightweight finish, the serum left my skin feeling hydrated and worked beautifully with my favorite moisturizer. The serum has a very subtle citrusy scent to it. The scent is light that most people may not notice it but I appreciated it. The compact, squeezable packaging also makes it super convenient to use. This has quickly become one of my favorite skincare products—5 stars and a must-have in your daily skincare routine.

I'm a religious sunscreen user, everyday multiple times a day. Skincare is the most important to me, and sunscreen is something I don't go without. This sun serum has a very light almost lemon pledge scent, it's not bad at all. It doesn't smell like normal sunscreen which is a plus for me. It's thinner because it is a serum, but not watery thin almost like a light moisturizer. It applies absolutely beautifully, it gives you a very nice glow, and it does NOT leave any sort of white cast on your skin. It's very light on your skin and very comparable to a moisturizer. Doesn't feel greasy at all. * I will say, I had a small cut on my finger when using this the first time and it did burn, if you have any open wounds on your face or even sensitive acne I would be careful and do a test patch. * other than that I'd 100% recommend and will purchase again. I really do love it. The bottle is great too, it's a squeeze bottle but firm and not flimsy, product comes out easily but doesn't pour out. It doesn't make a mess.

Great for Asian skin! It has worked very well for me, it takes great care of my face and doesn't leave your face white, it's very soft and light.This protected my skin well from the sun.Such a good sunscreen!
Such a pleasant light airy scent. Goes on smooth dis like frfr. Would recommend again and again. Not to mention NON GREASY like ya much needed.
